name: inventory-brief
description: Read warehouse inventory and prepare a prioritized restock brief. Use when the user asks which SKUs need attention; never place orders.
goal: Produce a restock brief identifying SKUs below their provided reorder threshold, with quantities, source timestamps, and missing-data notes.
inputs: Inventory records and their observation time
Reorder thresholds and target stock supplied by the user or API
steps: Confirm the warehouse and the intended reporting window.
Ask the host to call listInventory for the approved warehouse_id.
Compare each observed stock quantity with its supplied reorder threshold. Never invent a threshold.
Draft a table of SKU, stock on hand, threshold, shortfall, and source timestamp.
Check the arithmetic against the returned records and report missing or stale data.
success_criteria: Each reported SKU appears in the source response for the approved warehouse.
Shortfall calculations reproduce from the provided quantities and thresholds.
The brief contains no claim that a purchase order was placed.
constraints: Read and report only; do not create, send, or approve purchase orders.
Do not expose supplier tokens or credentials in output.
Mark unavailable inventory as unknown rather than zero.
